_readme: THE BROWSER APP'S OWN SENTENCES, EACH WITH THE REASON THE PHONE HAS NO TWIN FOR IT.
web/tools/check_web_literals.py fails a rider sentence typed into web/js or web/app/index.html
unless an entry here keeps it: `path` is the file, `text` a substring of the sentence
(a value the code fills in reads as …), `reason` why it is the browser's own — a function the
web has and the phone does not, or a twin another verifier already pins. An entry that
matches nothing fails too, so a sentence that moves to the kit takes its entry with it.
Everything else is said through say('group.key') out of docs/copy/app-words.json, which the
kit writes (AppShellCopy). docs/web-parity/words.md is the full inventory.
